snippet.title: Drill Keeper - Official Game Pass Announcement Trailer | ID@Xbox Fall 2026
snippet.description:
Get a fresh look at gameplay from Drill Keeper in this new trailer for the upcoming deck-building roguelike siege defense game as you travel the galaxy to secure vital resources for your people. In Drill Keeper, as a dutiful symbol of the future, you'll build fortresses around your mining operations to protect them from the dangers lurking in the depths of distant planets, designing labyrinthine pathways and traps to stall and bewilder the enemy. Build powerful synergies in your deck as it grows over a run, optimize your dig strategy to acquire resources for immediate and future use, and experiment with a multitude of heroes and factions. 

Drill Keeper is coming to PC Game Pass in summer 2027.

#IGN #Gaming #Xbox
